# JustWatch

> > JustWatch is a streaming search engine and entertainment platform that helps users find where to watch movies and TV shows across streaming services.

JustWatch provides streaming guides, watchlists, and content discovery tools for consumers, while JustWatch Media offers entertainment marketing, audience insights, and advertising solutions for industry professionals.

## Key Topics

- Streaming services
- Movies and TV shows
- Content discovery
- Watchlist management
- New releases
- Entertainment marketing
- Audience insights
- Digital video advertising
- Content data API
- First-party data
- Media buying
- Streaming guides
- Film catalog
- Creative services

## Core Platforms

- [Home | Just Watch TV](https://tv.justwatch.com/): Homepage for Just Watch TV streaming platform with new releases & watchlist
- [JustWatch Media - The only media company built for modern day entertainment](https://media.justwatch.com/): JustWatch Media's entertainment marketing & audience insights platform

## Streaming Guides

- [Yüzüklerin Efendisi Film Serisi Hangi Sırayla İzlenmeli?](https://guides.justwatch.com/tr/yuzuklerin-efendisi-sirayla-izle): Guide to watching Tolkien's Lord of the Rings & Hobbit films in order
